scope: Explicit evidence-conditioned rule choice into maintained practice

environment.execution: Isolated temporary candidate directory on authorized Linux QA host

visualInspection: Desktop and 390px mobile screenshots inspected; controls and comparisons are legible, with no document overflow.
evidence: Authored analytic observations; no physical learner or expert performance evidence.
limitations: Compatibility is conditional on original calibration and supplied measurement bounds.
Only the maintained five-rule family is compared; unobserved marks retain their original annotation.
Ambiguous survivors remain unresolved even after a user chooses one.
No cloud deployment, physical execution, contest qualification or learning transfer is established.
